title: LGBTQ+ content, communities and services (where promotion or information is restricted by law)
summary: Listed countries criminalise or restrict LGBTQ+ 'promotion', information or organisations, or block such content/apps, in addition to criminalising conduct in many cases. Some jurisdictions restrict only content directed at minors (Hungary, Singapore). Not individually listed: some US states restrict content for minors; local rules within countries (e.g. Indonesia's Aceh). Many laws are recent or pending (Ghana, Turkey, Kazakhstan, Senegal): verify status before relying on an entry.

countries.name: Russia
countries.note: 'LGBT propaganda' banned for all ages (Federal Law 478-FZ, Dec 2022); the Supreme Court designated the 'international LGBT movement' extremist (Nov 2023); fines and criminal liability for displaying symbols.

countries.name: Uganda
countries.note: Anti-Homosexuality Act 2023 (upheld by Constitutional Court April 2024) criminalises same-sex conduct and 'promotion' of homosexuality.

countries.name: Nigeria
countries.note: Same-Sex Marriage (Prohibition) Act 2014 criminalises public display of same-sex relationships and registering gay clubs/organisations.

countries.name: Ghana
countries.note: Bill to criminalise LGBTQ+ identity and promotion passed Parliament Feb 2024 but awaited presidential assent; 2025-26 reintroduction; same-sex conduct already criminal. Status unverified.

countries.name: Kenya
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct criminal (Penal Code s.162); Family Protection Bill proposals; courts allowed LGBT NGO registration (2023). Promotion not specifically criminalised.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct criminal; content 'violating public morals' prohibited and blocked under Anti-Cyber Crime Law.

countries.name: Iran
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct punishable up to death; LGBTQ+ content filtered.

countries.name: Iraq
countries.note: Law No. 8 of 2024 amended the Anti-Prostitution Law to criminalise same-sex relations and 'promoting homosexuality'.

countries.name: Afghanistan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Taliban treat same-sex conduct as criminal; LGBTQ+ content prohibited.

countries.name: Yemen
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct punishable by death; content prohibited.

countries.name: Qatar
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct criminal; LGBTQ+ content censored.

countries.name: Kuwait
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct and cross-dressing criminal; 'promotion' content blocked.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct criminal; Cybercrime Law and Media Content standards prohibit LGBTQ+ content.

countries.name: Brunei
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Sharia Penal Code Order 2013 criminalises same-sex conduct; moratorium on death penalty (2023).

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Penal Code s.377A-B and state Sharia laws; LGBT content censored by MCMC and film censors.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Aceh Sharia qanun criminalises same-sex conduct; national ITE Law/pornography law used against LGBT content; LGBT apps blocked. New Criminal Code in force 2026.

countries.name: Pakistan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Penal Code s.377; Grindr blocked; LGBT content blocked by PTA.

countries.name: Bangladesh
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Penal Code s.377; LGBT content may be blocked under Cyber Security law.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.note: No explicit law, but 'debauchery' Law 10/1961 and Cybercrime Law 175/2018 used to prosecute; LGBT content blocked.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.note: No criminal ban on being LGBT; Pride bans, site blocking and 2025 draft laws criminalising 'behaviour contrary to biological sex' and promotion; 'Year of the Family'. Status of 2025 proposals unverified.

countries.name: Hungary
countries.note: Act LXXIX of 2021 ('child protection') prohibits making content on homosexuality/gender change available to minors; 2025 amendments restrict Pride assemblies; CJEU/Commission challenge pending.

countries.name: Georgia
countries.note: Law on Protecting Family Values and Minors (adopted Sept 2024) bans 'LGBT propaganda' and restricts gender recognition, same-sex marriage and related content.

countries.name: Kazakhstan
countries.note: Law banning 'LGBT propaganda' to the public passed Parliament in Nov-Dec 2025 and reportedly signed; fines and short detention. Verify enactment and scope.

countries.name: Kyrgyzstan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Law 'On Protecting Children from Harmful Information' (2023) bans promotion of 'non-traditional sexual relations'; proposed criminal penalties.

countries.name: Belarus
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. 2024 amendments to the Law on Mass Media/child-protection treat 'propaganda of non-traditional sexual relations' as pornography-like; criminal liability.

countries.name: Oman
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct criminal; content censored.

countries.name: Sudan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct criminal.

countries.name: Libya
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct criminal; Libyan authorities have targeted LGBT content.

countries.name: Senegal
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Penal Code art. 319(3); 2026 proposals to toughen penalties. Verify.

countries.name: Malawi
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct criminal; moratorium on enforcement.

countries.name: Tanzania
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Same-sex conduct criminal; government has threatened to block LGBT content online.

countries.name: Burkina Faso
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. 2025 law criminalises homosexuality. From general knowledge; verify.

countries.name: Mali
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Criminalised same-sex acts by new law 2024-25. From general knowledge; verify.

countries.name: Turkmenistan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Criminal Code art. 135 (male same-sex conduct).

countries.name: Uzbekistan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Criminal Code art. 120 (male same-sex conduct); 'propaganda' content blocked.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. IMDA codes restrict LGBT content for minors; s.377A repealed 2022 but marriage constitutionally protected.

countries.name: China
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. No criminal law; LGBT content censored by CAC/NRTA; LGBT groups' social media accounts shut down.

countries.name: Syria
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Penal Code art. 520 criminalises same-sex conduct.
